title: Let a browser dial your agent with no dashboard setup
summary: A SWML webhook resource whose primary_request_url is your agent's URL is a thing a browser can dial: you list its Fabric addresses over REST and mint a guest token whose allowed_addresses names one, with no Dashboard step.
scenario: A support page whose talk-to-us button should reach the agent you deployed a minute ago, with no Dashboard visit first

folds: demo example (the canonical shape 12 demos copy)
evidence: tools/openapi/rest.json POST /api/fabric/resources/swml_webhooks: primary_request_url required; used_for calling|messaging
tools/openapi/rest.json POST /api/fabric/guests/tokens: allowed_addresses required (up to 10), expire_at; 201 token, refresh_token
